title: Eighteen Hundred Miles on a Burmese Tat: through Burmah, Siam, and the Eastern Shan States
author: Capt. G. J. Younghusband
description: Pioneering late nineteenth-century expedition across the Shan plateau, detailing Tai urban architecture, monastery schools, palm-leaf manuscript production, cross-border caravan trails, and ethnolinguistic classifications matching Tai Khamyang and Khamti groups.
